=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2061 and 2601 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `git cat-file -e HEAD:.github/workflows` fails when HEAD has no `.github/workflows` tree, skipping the restore/clean block and letting unintended workflow commits through.
  WHY: The reviewer verified the behavior but judged it practically impossible and not actionable because repositories using these workflows already have `.github/workflows` in HEAD.
- tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py:846-881 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `test_protect_workflow_files_restores_deleted_workflow_directory` only covers the case where `.github/workflows` exists in HEAD and is deleted from the worktree, not the case where HEAD never had it.
  WHY: The reviewer says the test covers the confirmed regression path but not the synthetic HEAD-absent path, which they judge non-actionable.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:line ~2062
  PROBLEM: `git reset -q HEAD -- .github/workflows` on the temp index does not recurse into subdirs if `.github` exists but `workflows` was deleted.
  WHY: The reviewer says this claim is incorrect because `git reset` with a directory pathspec resets all matching index entries and the temp index is seeded from HEAD.
